title: Suggestions for review, none implemented pending the owner's choice
decision_fields_blank_by_design: every row carries decision = null so the owner chooses before anything is built

rows.suggestion: Put the decision-readiness table on the landing page, with the gate and the clearing number
rows.why: the landing page is the one page a reviewer reads
rows.expected_effect: one row per requirement; a reviewer can see in one screen what is blocked and what would unblock it

rows.suggestion: Publish the staking division empty, with its reason, instead of hiding it
rows.why: an empty division is a finding; a hidden one is an omission
rows.expected_effect: a reader cannot mistake a proper-score result for a profitable one

rows.suggestion: Show the residual distribution, not only the mean residual
rows.why: a mean hides a fat tail that would decide staking if it were allowed
rows.expected_effect: per-market residual quantiles on the origination page

rows.suggestion: Give every requirement row a machine-readable clearing number
rows.why: prose gates cannot be checked; numbers can
rows.expected_effect: a verifier can assert that a row claiming 'blocked' carries a clearing number

rows.suggestion: Keep the league table and the skill table apart
rows.why: standings measure teams, the leaderboard measures forecasts
rows.expected_effect: no reader can confuse a 8-1 record with a calibrated model

rows.suggestion: Publish the pre-registration hash on the leaderboard itself
rows.why: a score without its registration is a number without a warrant
rows.expected_effect: each leaderboard row links to the commit that froze its rule

rows.suggestion: Treat 'blank' as a first-class value in every table
rows.why: the brief's own rule: never infer a value
rows.expected_effect: a reviewer can count blanks; the verifier already counts them per page

rows.suggestion: Add a per-team view of out players and named replacements
rows.why: the brief asks for a quick team-level decision view
rows.expected_effect: a reader can see one club's availability without reading 253 rows

rows.suggestion: Publish the availability delta as a series, not a single pair
rows.why: one delta cannot show a trend; two can start one
rows.expected_effect: each week's pair joins the series and the trend becomes visible

rows.suggestion: Let the suggestions page carry a decision column and a date
rows.why: a suggestion with no decision path is a wish
rows.expected_effect: the owner can mark accept/decline with a date, and the page keeps the history

rows.suggestion: Show the two total estimators side by side with the gap
rows.why: the brief asks for both until one wins
rows.expected_effect: the gap column makes the disagreement visible instead of hidden in a choice

rows.suggestion: Add a control row to every future leaderboard run, forever
rows.why: a leaderboard without a control is a leaderboard of one
rows.expected_effect: the climatology control already runs; make it a hard precondition

rows.suggestion: Publish this lab's own numbers with their capture dates, never as 'live'
rows.why: a stale number presented as live is the defect this repo repeats
rows.expected_effect: every table header states the date of the data behind it

rows.suggestion: Put the egress limitation on the landing page, not only in the flags
rows.why: a reader must know that today's build read no page live
rows.expected_effect: no reader can mistake a stored capture for a fresh read
